name: Anna Belle
title: Your South Austin & East Riverside apartment search
intro: Studios and 1-bedrooms in South Austin, most within about 15 minutes of your office on MoPac, plus a few in East Riverside you asked about, all within your $1,500 budget. Almost every community here offers in-unit washers and dryers (I've noted the ones that don't), and prices refresh every morning from each building's own website. Save the ones you like and send them to me, and I'll confirm pricing and set up tours.

picks.note: Just a few minutes from your office, in Barton Hills near the Barton Creek Greenbelt trails.
Set on a large wooded preserve off Southwest Parkway with its own hike-and-bike trails.
Shaded by old oak trees in Sunset Valley, with easy shopping nearby and a quick drive up MoPac.
The most space for the money on this list, near the Veloway and Wildflower Center. A bit farther out, about 15–20 minutes to work.
